title: Bitdeer Hits 95% of AI Cloud Target via 60MW Malaysia Deal

tickers.name: Bitdeer Technologies Group Class A Ordinary Shares

summary:
An 8 year services agreement for the A103 site will allow a Bitcoin mining company to grow its infrastructure in Cyberjaya. Bitdeer AI secured 60 MW of capacity at the facility, bringing its global AI Cloud portfolio to 333.5 MW, or 95% of its 350 MW target. The facility is designed to house Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin systems and will begin operations in Q1 2028.

The Bitcoin miner is expanding beyond cryptocurrency mining to establish itself in the AI infrastructure market. This development in Malaysia is part of a strategic shift to build high-performance computing services on a global scale.
